subject.description: Academic course subject domain (Mathematics or Portuguese Language).

academic_year.description: Academic calendar year of coursework observation.

attendance_percentage.description: Estimated attendance proxy percentage derived from absence count assuming a 60-session term baseline (100 - (min(absences, 60)/60 * 100)). This is an estimated proxy and NOT verified institutional roll-call attendance.

study_hours_per_week.description: Estimated weekly self-study hours mapped from ordinal survey category midpoints (<2h -> 1.5, 2-5h -> 3.5, 5-10h -> 7.5, >10h -> 12.0). These are approximate midpoint estimates, not stopwatch-logged study hours. Original survey categories are preserved in 'studytime'.

assignment_completion_rate.description: Percentage of homework and continuous coursework submissions completed.

previous_exam_marks.description: Period 1 (G1) evaluation scaled to percentage scale (0-100%).

quiz_scores.description: Period 2 (G2) continuous evaluation score scaled to percentage (0-100%).

final_exam_marks.description: Final term examination mark (G3) scaled to percentage (0-100%). Target label.

academic_status.description: Three-tier academic risk classification based on target performance.

school.description: Student secondary educational institution code (GP: Gabriel Pereira, MS: Mousinho da Silveira).

sex.description: Biological sex of student (F: Female, M: Male).

failures.description: Number of previous academic class failures.

absences.description: Raw count of school absences across the semester.
